analysis_plan.scope: synthetic development only; after run completion but before first numerical outcome inspection
analysis_plan.required_integrity: Both controllers complete; original source/input/forecast/output hashes; full48-update grid and784generations perseed; saved adapters unchanged and all restores passed; forecast lock precedes every outcome mtime and code enforces no updates before lock; deadline compliance; archive originalsource

endpoints.mean_token_logp: same contrasts after dividing each sequence logp by its own scored token count including EOS
endpoints.four_choice_probability: softmax over four summed sequence scores only; format P(numbered_short)+P(numbered_long); verbosity P(plain_long)+P(numbered_long). Conditional on these four completions, not unrestricted behavior.

analysis_plan.comparisons: All6methods,3rates,2seeds,4styles and pooled; full per-probe same-probe forecasts and calibration-average forecasts transferred to independent-template evaluation questions; actual calibration-to-evaluation contrast mismatch diagnostic labeled non-prospective
analysis_plan.metrics: RMSE, RMSE / zero-forecast RMSE, MAE, actual/predicted RMS, actual-on-prediction through-origin slope, signed bias, correlation; perbatch nRMSE median/p90/max; paired method error comparisons vs SVD16 and zero
analysis_plan.uncertainty: 2000 crossed batch/probe bootstrap draws within each fixedseed; batch resampling stratified by4styles; paired predictions/outcomes/methods. Pointwise95% intervals, descriptive/unadjusted; noseedpopulation or confirmatory claims. Perstyle estimates fourbatchesonly. RNG8173
analysis_plan.free_generation: Exact tags/order, alltagspresent, numberedformat, outputtokens/words, empty, truncation at120, repeated4gram/consecutive-token flags; compare all48updates against matching16baselineprompts; report allstyles/rates/seeds
analysis_plan.examples: Use batch indices0,1,2,3; evaluation indices0,1; everyrate and bothseeds with baseline, regardless outcomes; fixed before inspection
analysis_plan.limits: No generated-behavior predictor fitted; plot surrogate changes versus actual number-format changes as descriptive associationonly; 2reusedseeds/hardwareconfounded; synthetic; no novelorconfirmationclaim; data developed aftersteering; never omitnegativecomparisons
analysis_plan.next_step: Choose next development hypothesis only after complete evidence; new confirmation requires fresh locked protocol/data.
